summary: Global Mofy AI Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an offering of 8,247,420 Class A ordinary shares accompanied by Series A and Series B warrants, at a price of $0.97 per unit. The Series A warrants have a five-year term and a reset feature based on 80% of the lowest VWAP during a ten-day period, with a floor of $0.194; Series B warrants have a two-year term and allow cashless exercise. The company is raising capital through this equity-linked structure. There is no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for dilution from warrant exercises and the potential impact of the reset price mechanism on share price.
